ARI.description: prompt without a control token, simply with a target ARI value
ARI.prompt:
INSTRUCTION: Simplify the following text such that its Automated Readability Index (ARI) score is approximately equal to {TARGET_VALUE}. 
SOURCE TEXT: {TEXT}

ARI.description: prompt with a control token, which will be replaced with the target ARI value
ARI.prompt:
INSTRUCTION: Simplify the following text such that its Automated Readability Index (ARI) score is approximately equal to that specified in the control token prepended to your generated simplification. The control token has the following format: <METRIC=VALUE>. The control token prepended to the source text indicates the ARI value of the source text. 
SOURCE TEXT: <ARI={SOURCE_VALUE}> {TEXT}

KEEP.description: prompt without a control token, simply instructing to keep the listed numbers
KEEP.prompt:
INSTRUCTION: Simplify the following text while preserving exactly (unchanged and without omission) the following numbers: {VALUE}. 
SOURCE TEXT: {TEXT}

KEEP.description: prompt with a control token listing the numbers that must be preserved
KEEP.prompt:
INSTRUCTION: Simplify the following text. You MUST preserve, exactly and without omission, every numerical value listed in the control token prepended to your generated simplification. The control token has the following format: <KEEP=VALUE>, where VALUE lists the numbers to keep. The control token prepended to the source text lists the numbers found in the source text that must be preserved. 
SOURCE TEXT: <KEEP={SOURCE_VALUE}> {TEXT}
